replacement.title: Screenshot 6 Google TV Device Presentation
replacement.definition: Present the sixth iOS screenshot as demonstrating that viewing is available on any Google TV device.

patches.decision_note: Screenshot 6 has its own requested visual correction and implementation trajectory, independent of screenshots 1 and 2.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
Thanks, Mehtab! Generally looks great, here are a few comments to address:
1\. First image looks good but the expressions on the faces are upset/sad. Please change the facial impression to something more suitable
2\. Remove the violence pill from the top, keep nudity, kissing and profanity. Also the top photo shows active kissing, please hide it or replace with a photo that suggests kissing but does not actually show it.
3, 4, 5: look good
6\. Can you replace with something that shows that you can watch on any Google TV device?

execution.observed_behavior: The client observed an unwanted violence pill and an image showing active kissing in screenshot 2.
